checks.explanation: F1's revenue rose 14% year-over-year to $3.87B in 2025 and grew a further 53% in Q1 2026, while Liberty Media's F1 equity stake (bought for $8B in 2017) is now valued at over $26B, confirming the predicted continued climb in both revenue and valuation.

sources.title: F1 revenue rises 14% to US$3.87bn in 2025
